label: VK
terms_note: VK Developer Terms; free. 3 rps per user token / 20 rps per community token; per-method limits are undisclosed and answer with error 6/9 or a captcha (14). Russian law requires ERID labelling on advertising.

sdks: vk-api (Python, community), official VK SDKs (Android / iOS / JS)

auth: 1. VK ID / Standalone app → user token (OAuth 2.0 / VK ID SDK) with scopes `wall`, `photos`, `video`, `groups`,
2. Callback API (server URL per community, confirmation string, secret) or Long Poll for events.

endpoints.call: wall.post` {owner_id (negative = community), from_group=1, message, attachments `photo{owner}_{id},video…,link`, publish_date (unix → scheduled / postponed), signed, copyright, photo_attachments_crop

reference.limits: - 3 requests/s per user token; 20 requests/s per community token; service token 5–20 rps by audience size; undisclosed quantitative per-method limits → temporary unavailability or captcha (error 14). - Content rules for audio / polls / files; advertising must carry ERID labelling under Russian law. - Free; VK Developer Terms. Sanctions compliance may restrict its use.

reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 in headless Chromium: wall.post, wall.createComment and wall.delete still require 'ключ доступа пользователя, полученный в Standalone-приложении через Implicit Flow (требуется право доступа: wall — выдаётся в исключительных случаях через запрос в поддержку по электронной почте devsupport@corp.vk.com)' (https://dev.vk.com/ru/method/wall.post), and a user access key lives 1 hour ('Срок действия ключа доступа пользователя — 1 час', https://dev.vk.com/ru/api/access-token/implicit-flow-user). Without that exceptional grant no posting call can be made, and the runtime has no flow that renews a 1-hour VK user key.
